simple.meaning: נֶגֶד (neged) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a front , i.e. part opposite ; specifically a counterpart , or mate ; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 150 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 2:18. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֶגֶד (H5048).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נֶגֶד (neged) / H5048 is traced through Genesis 2:18, Genesis 2:20, Genesis 21:16, Genesis 31:32 as a generated source-based concept entry.
